scenes.line1: Why do .NET apps suddenly slow down?
scenes.line2: Is thread pool starvation to blame?
scenes.say: Why do your .NET apps suddenly slow down? Is thread pool starvation the culprit?

scenes.label: Starvation
scenes.sub: All thread pool threads are busy, delaying tasks.
scenes.say: Thread pool starvation means all threads are busy, so new tasks get delayed.
Blocking calls, too much synchronous work, and heavy load are the main causes.

scenes.title: Check available threads
scenes.say: Use ThreadPool dot GetAvailableThreads to see how many threads are free. Zero means starvation.

scenes.question: How do you prevent starvation?
scenes.wrong: Add more threads to the pool.
scenes.right: Avoid blocking calls and use async patterns.
scenes.say: Interviewers want solutions. Adding threads isn't enough. Avoid blocking and use async patterns.
